observations: Steal An Egg (110 days), Brookhaven, Throw Food For Animals, DONT SPLASH (26 days), RIVALS and 99 Nights in the Forest lead the pillar for a fourth day, so the top group still barely moves (H-mp-008, 45%).
Ragdoll Realism (+47, 16 days) rose most, ahead of Raise The Biggest Family (+21), Clone Baby Care (Anomaly) (+17), 13 Days to Escape (+15) and Can You Pass A Driving Test? (+14).
Push the Patient (-37), Climb For Animals Eggs (-29) and three older ragdoll sandboxes, Ragdoll Reality (-29), Realistic Ragdoll Engine (-25) and Ragdoll Sandbox (-24), fell most.

Nineteen games entered and nineteen left: entries include two more ragdoll sandboxes (Bloody Ragdoll Physics, Hyper Realistic Ragdoll), Do Not Stop., Build a Bridge, A Bizarre Run and Flee the Facility at 3,421 days; Bug Evolution, Cut a Rock, Say Cheese! and +1 Baddie Evolution left.

Past a year the median pillar percentile is the 71st against the 45th at 15-42 days and the 31st at 43-84 days; the 4-12 month band sits at the 54th (n=9), so the mid-life trough (H-mp-009, 45%) still does not show.
patterns: Higher prices consistently go with dominance: a median pass above 149 R$ holds at 75% (H-mp-001), and median products above 399 R$ split days on the chart at r=+0.39, with game age a likely confounder.

Recent updates tend to go with staying power: games updated within a week stay longer (H-mp-018, 65%; more than 30 days since an update splits days on the chart at r=-0.62) and H-mp-006 recovered from 41% to 61%.

Multiplayer tends to beat solo (H-mp-003, 42% to 64%), and among profiled loops steal-and-defend (79th median percentile), roleplay (68th) and PvP combat (67th) sit high while party minigames (18th), idle tycoons (25th) and obbies (28th) sit low.

Originality no longer goes with higher positions: H-mp-013 fell from 61% to 18%, because the leaders include template games (Steal An Egg, Throw Food For Animals) and the ragdoll clones that entered today; originality is speculative here, unlike on the breakout charts.
A high favorite rate per visit consistently marks smaller games (H-mp-010, 87%), since big evergreens convert fewer visits into favorites.

outliers.name: 🎃Flee the Facility🍁
outliers.note: Re-entered Most Popular at more than nine years old after a late Halloween event shipped on 10 November, and rose 415 on Top Earning the same day.

outliers.name: [ATTACHMENTS] Ragdoll Realism
outliers.note: Rose 47 places at 16 days while ragdoll sandboxes aged 27-31 days fell 24-29, so the wave's share is moving to its newest members.

outliers.note: Fell 37, the largest drop, despite a same-day update; a fixed-stage two-player obby at 53 days fits the short life of finite obbies (H-mp-025, 57%).

observations: Summer Donations, Clover RPG and Bloodlines (both five or more years old), Enter Brainrot, Those Who Remain and Momo City lead efficiency: donation hubs, old RPGs and roleplay again.
Ragdoll Physics, Bloody Ragdoll Physics, MALAM SAMA OPAH and Unstable SMP FFA are the least efficient: large young audiences with thin or new stores.

Flee the Facility (+415) rose most after its late Halloween event, ahead of Cultivation Unbound (+166), Unstable SMP FFA (+143), Chaos Battlegrounds (+131) and Survive a Psycho (+130); Momo City (-168), 10 Player Flee (-86), Impossible Animals (-73) and Survive The Swarm (-72) fell most.

Nineteen games entered, among them +1 Drain Water for Treasure, Drill City: Chicago, Jujutsu Farm, Raise a Champion, Tavern Town and Tiny Skies; fourteen left, including House TD 2, Spin To Upgrade! and Hide to Steal Eggs.
Efficiency consistently rises with age, from the 25th median percentile at 15-42 days to the 63rd past a year (H-te-001, 84%).
patterns: High prices consistently pay: median products above 79 R$ split efficiency at r=+0.42 (H-te-005, 95%), and a median pass above 399 R$ (H-te-025) and a top pass above 999 R$ (H-te-006) hold at 95%.

RPGs (r=+0.55), roleplay hubs (74th median percentile), story adventures (73rd), PvP combat (r=+0.26) and tower defense consistently earn more per player; physics sandboxes (r=-0.58), steal-and-defend loops (23rd), Survival-genre games (r=-0.32) and solo loops (r=-0.29) consistently earn less.

'+1' titles consistently earn less per player (H-te-004, 72% to 84%), and the Ragdoll (r=-0.67) and Steal (r=-0.49) title keywords are the weakest, while Defense (+0.38) and Life (+0.33) are the strongest.
Character-art thumbnails consistently go with revenue (H-te-048, 95%) and reward-flex thumbnails against it (H-te-029, 95%), the opposite of what wins on Up-and-Coming.
Same-day updates add nothing here: recent updates fell from 44% to 32% (H-te-017), and games updated in the last day moved -4 against -3 for the rest.

outliers.name: Drill City: Chicago
outliers.note: Entered Top Earning at 25 days with only 326K visits: a whitelisted hood roleplay selling cash packs up to 2,499 R$ and capacity passes to a small, high-spending audience (98% likes), in line with H-te-026 and H-te-005.

outliers.name: [🎃]Momo City [Beta]

outliers.name: [W3] +1 Drain Water for Treasure

observations: The Ditch Hotel (12 days), Hyper Realistic Ragdoll (14 days), Barber Simulator, Build a REAL House, Troll Grab Tower and Unstable SMP FFA lead early momentum.

The Ditch Hotel (+38), Barber Simulator (+24), Net a Fish! (+23), Malam Bersama Kaka (+19) and Build a REAL House (+19) rose most; +1 Baddie Evolution (-38), Ragdoll Physics 2 (-23), Project Web (-22) and Untitled Symbiote Suit Game (-19) fell most.

Fourteen games entered, among them Ragdoll Soccer, Voxel Wars, Harpoon a Fish, Sleepover (Story), Draw an aquarium and Cook Pizzas [Anomaly], plus Toilet Tower Defense at 1,244 days after its OG-lobby update; fourteen left, including Make The Logo!, Urban Reload and Monster Maker.

Games updated in the last day moved -5 against 0 for the rest, so a same-day update again shows no immediate edge, though recently updated young games still tend to climb faster over time (H-tt-005, 71%).
The 0-14 day band holds the 99th median percentile (n=3) against the 55th at 15-42 days and the 38th at 43-84 days.
patterns: Survival framing consistently helps: survival mechanics go with faster climbs (r=+0.49, within-age +0.40) and higher positions (+0.45), and H-tt-048 holds at 73%.

Originality consistently helps: more novel concepts hold higher positions (H-tt-069, 77%) and climb faster (r=+0.33, within-age +0.31), so the old template-climbs-faster idea stays low (H-tt-002, 28%).
Pet and egg mechanics go with much lower positions (r=-0.40, 12 games) and physics-sandbox mechanics with higher ones (r=+0.33); both are proposed as tests today.

Lean stores consistently do better: more than 55 developer products (H-tt-063, 72%) and currency packs (H-tt-067, 72%) go with lower positions, and like-begging descriptions with slower climbs (H-tt-061, 71%).
Gameplay thumbnails now consistently go with higher positions (H-tt-029, 46% to 71%), while speed passes no longer look harmful (H-tt-070, 70% to 32%).

outliers.note: Rose 38 at 12 days with a bracket tag, one of three update-tagged leaders that pulled H-tt-007 (bracket tags hurt) down to 48%.

observations: Ragdoll Soccer (30 days, 73% likes), Hyper Realistic Ragdoll, Bloody Ragdoll Physics, Do Not Stop., Build a REAL House and Survive Your Ideas top the chart.

Draw the Other Half! (+68), Teleport Duels (+47), Bobby's Daycare [HORROR] (+34), BONK! Ragdoll Boxing (+29) and Build to Fight Zombies (+28) rose most; +1 Baddie Evolution (-49), Untitled Symbiote Suit Game (-42), Project Web (-33) and Realistic Ragdoll Physics (-24) fell most.

Nineteen games entered and nineteen left. The entries profiled today span ragdoll sandboxes (Ragdoll Frenzy at 9 days, the 2D Pumpkin Playground), a bomb-volleyball party game (Volley Bomb, 94% likes), a robot-vacuum cleaner, a tsunami sand-wall builder, two '+1' evolutions and two steal-egg reskins.
Games updated in the last day moved -6 against -1 for the rest, though over time recent updates consistently go with higher positions (H-uc-012, 81%).
The 0-14 day band holds the 66th median percentile against the 50th at 15-42 days (H-uc-005, 60%).
patterns: Original concepts consistently rank higher (H-uc-039, 84%; within-age +0.40), while steal mechanics sit lowest (within-age -0.62) and collection indexes low (-0.33); the steal test is proposed today.
Co-op (H-uc-019, 60% to 80%), survival framing (H-uc-047, 78%), horror escapes (H-uc-057, 75%) and physics sandboxes (H-uc-036, 42% to 76%) consistently go with higher positions.

Plain presentation consistently does better: no emoji in the title (H-uc-064, 78%), no text or numbers on thumbnails (H-uc-017, 79%), no bracket tags (H-uc-004, 74%) and no join-the-group ask (H-uc-065, 74%).

Launch stores tend to matter less than loops, but revives (H-uc-021, 73%) and storage passes (H-uc-052, 74%) consistently go with higher positions, while daily rewards (H-uc-062, 70%) and leaderboards (H-uc-061, 71%) go with lower ones.
Like ratio no longer tracks position (H-uc-006, 64% to 40%): Ragdoll Soccer leads at 73% likes while RoChess and Volley Bomb sit lower with 78-94%.

summary: The ragdoll wave rotates to its newest members (H-x-021, 82%): Ragdoll Realism (16 days) rose 47 on Most Popular and two 12-14 day ragdoll games entered it while three aged 27-31 days fell 24-29; a new qualitative hypothesis tracks this replacement inside waves. Physics sandboxes rank high again on Up-and-Coming (H-uc-036, 76%) but stay at the bottom of Top Earning.

What wins breakout and what earns still split: originality, plain titles, gameplay thumbnails and lean stores consistently go with Up-and-Coming and Top Trending, while character-art thumbnails, high prices, RPGs and roleplay go with Top Earning efficiency. Originality no longer helps on Most Popular (H-mp-013, 18%).
Survival is a breakout genre, not a revenue genre: it consistently lifts Top Trending (H-tt-048, 73%) and Up-and-Coming (H-uc-047, 78%) but earns less per player (H-te-021, 95%).

Late events still pay: Flee the Facility's 10 November Halloween update lifted it 415 places on Top Earning and back onto Most Popular, while pumpkin-tagged games without a new event, led by Momo City (-168), fell (H-x-027 to 60%).

Gameplay videos are still unlabelled for the twelfth run: Dragon Adventures, Creatures of Sonaria, Sol's RNG and Basketball: Zero are frames_ready with 0 frames and no contact sheets on the videos branch. No new outside research was waiting. 47 games were profiled today.
progressions: uc→tt remains the most common transition (243 entries, up from 236, median 2 days), ahead of tt→mp (194, up from 180, median 2 days).
uc→te (151, 5 days), tt→te (139, 4 days) and uc→mp (135, up from 122, 4 days) keep showing breakouts reaching revenue and dominance within about a week, while tt→uc stays at 1.

Bloody Ragdoll Physics and Hyper Realistic Ragdoll went from Up-and-Coming and Top Trending to Most Popular within 12-14 days of launch; Bloody Ragdoll Physics also entered Top Earning, as one of its least efficient games.
